final_text: The bug is fixed: `rdata2`'s write-bypass was missing the `we` qualifier (it bypassed on address match alone), and both ports lacked the explicit raddr==0 priority. I added `raddr==0` as the top-priority case and required `we` for the bypass on both ports. All tests pass (`TEST PASSED`).
